evidence.quote: Absent a clear and sustained improvement in labor market conditions, we should remain ready to adjust policy to bring it closer to neutral.
We should also avoid signaling that we will pause without identifying that conditions have changed.
On the employment side, I continue to see downside risks.
The underlying trend in core PCE inflation appears to be moving much closer to our 2 percent target than is currently showing in the data.
Although the labor market is still near full employment, it has become increasingly more fragile and could continue to deteriorate in the coming months.
my view is that we should continue to focus on risks to our employment mandate and preemptively stabilize and support labor market conditions.

parsed.rationale: The speaker sees policy as moderately restrictive, inflation near target excluding tariffs, and labor market fragility as the greater risk, and explicitly argues against signaling a pause while favoring further moves toward neutral. This is a clearly dovish signal for additional cuts.
